  [1;91m9[0m  [1;91m━━━━○━━━━[0m  （五, 5th）─────────────────▶ [1;97m8[0m  [1;97m━━━   ━━━[0m  （五, 5th）

  [1;91m9[0m  [1;91m━━━━○━━━━[0m  （二, 2nd）─────────────────▶ [1;97m8[0m  [1;97m━━━   ━━━[0m  （二, 2nd）

[1;90mSTANDING HEXAGRAM 1:

[0m(Line at bottom is first)

  [1;91m9  ━━━━○━━━━  [0m（上, 6th）──┐
  [1;91m9  ━━━━○━━━━  [0m（五, 5th）──┼── 天（上卦）

  [1;91m9  ━━━━○━━━━  [0m（二, 2nd）──┼── 天（下卦）
  [1;91m9  ━━━━○━━━━  [0m（初, 1st）──┘   Heaven, the Sky (lower trigram)

[0m(First is line at bottom)

  [1;91m9, [1;91m9, [1;91m9, [1;91m9, [1;91m9, [1;91m9

[1;90mSTANDING HEXAGRAM NAME:

[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m乾

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mI. The Khien Hexagram


[1;90mSTANDING HEXAGRAM STRUCTURE:

  [90m互卦 Nuclear Hexagram:  [1;97m#1 乾 / I. The Khien Hexagram[0m
  [90m錯卦 Inverse Hexagram:  [1;97m#2 坤 / II. The Khwăn Hexagram[0m
  [90m綜卦 Reversed Hexagram: [1;97m#1 乾 / I. The Khien Hexagram[0m


[1;90m卦辭:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m乾：元亨，利貞。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mKhien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm.

[1;90m大象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m天行健，君子以自強不息。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mI. Heaven, in its motion, (gives the idea of) strength. The superior man, in accordance with this, nerves himself to ceaseless activity.

[1;90m初九:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m初九：潛龍，勿用。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m1. In the first (or lowest) NINE, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon lying hid (in the deep). It is not the time for active doing.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m潛龍勿用，陽在下也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m1. 'The dragon lies hid in the deep;--it is not the time for active doing:'--(this appears from) the strong and undivided line's being in the lowest place.

[1;90m九二:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m九二：見龍在田，利見大人。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m2. In the second NINE, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon appearing in the field. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m見龍在田，德施普也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m2. 'The dragon appears in the field:'--the diffusion of virtuous influence has been wide.

[1;90m九三:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m九三：君子終日乾乾，夕惕若，厲，无咎。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m3. In the third NINE, undivided, (we see its subject as) the superior man active and vigilant all the day, and in the evening still careful and apprehensive. (The position is) dangerous, but there will be no mistake.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m終日乾乾，反復道也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m3. 'Active and vigilant all the day:'--(this refers to) the treading of the (proper) path over and over again.

[1;90m九四:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m九四：或躍在淵，无咎。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m4. In the fourth NINE, undivided, (we see its subject as the dragon looking) as if he were leaping up, but still in the deep. There will be no mistake.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m或躍在淵，進无咎也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m4. 'He seems to be leaping up, but is still in the deep:'--if he advance, there will be no error.

[1;90m九五:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m九五：飛龍在天，利見大人。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m5. In the fifth NINE, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon on the wing in the sky. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m飛龍在天，大人造也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m5. 'The dragon is on the wing in the sky:'--the great man rouses himself to his work.

[1;90m上九:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m上九：亢龍有悔。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m6. In the sixth (or topmost) NINE, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon exceeding the proper limits. There will be occasion for repentance.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m亢龍有悔，盈不可久也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m6. 'The dragon exceeds the proper limits;--there will be occasion for repentance:'--a state of fulness, that is, should not be indulged in long.

[1;90m用九:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m用九：見群龍无首，吉。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m(The lines of this hexagram are all strong and undivided, as appears from) the use of the number nine. If the host of dragons (thus) appearing were to divest themselves of their heads, there would be good fortune.

[1;90m小象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m用九，天德不可為首也。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97m'The same undivided line is used' (in all the places of this hexagram), but the attribute of heaven (thereby denoted) should not (always) take the foremost place.


[1;90mEMERGING HEXAGRAM 2:

[0m(Line at bottom is first)

  [1;97m8  ━━━   ━━━  [0m（上, 6th）──┐
  [1;97m8  ━━━   ━━━  [0m（五, 5th）──┼── 地（上卦）
  [1;97m8  ━━━   ━━━  [0m（四, 4th）──┘   The earth (upper trigram)
  [1;97m8  ━━━   ━━━  [0m（三, 3rd）──┐
  [1;97m8  ━━━   ━━━  [0m（二, 2nd）──┼── 地（下卦）
  [1;97m8  ━━━   ━━━  [0m（初, 1st）──┘   The earth (lower trigram)

[0m(First is line at bottom)

  [1;97m8, [1;97m8, [1;97m8, [1;97m8, [1;97m8, [1;97m8

[1;90mEMERGING HEXAGRAM NAME:

[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m坤

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mII. The Khwăn Hexagram


[1;90mEMERGING HEXAGRAM STRUCTURE:

  [90m互卦 Nuclear Hexagram:  [1;97m#2 坤 / II. The Khwăn Hexagram[0m
  [90m錯卦 Inverse Hexagram:  [1;97m#1 乾 / I. The Khien Hexagram[0m
  [90m綜卦 Reversed Hexagram: [1;97m#2 坤 / II. The Khwăn Hexagram[0m


[1;90m卦辭:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m坤：元亨，利牝馬之貞。君子有攸往，先迷後得主，利西南得朋，東北喪朋。安貞，吉。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mKhwăn (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and having the firmness of a mare. When the superior man (here intended) has to make any movement, if he take the initiative, he will go astray; if he follow, he will find his (proper) lord. The advantageousness will be seen in his getting friends in the south-west, and losing friends in the north-east. If he rest in correctness and firmness, there will be good fortune.

[1;90m大象:
[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m地勢坤，君子以厚德載物。

[90m[Legge]

  [1;97mII. The (capacity and sustaining) power of the earth is what is denoted by Khwăn. The superior man, in accordance with this, with his large virtue supports (men and) things.


[1;90mEDITIONS AND WITNESSES:

[90m[武英殿本]

  [1;97m武英殿十三經注疏本《周易正義》 (1739)
